topics.title: Europe braces for eclipse night
topics.summary: A rare total solar eclipse crosses parts of Europe Wednesday, with Spain, Iceland, Greenland and Portugal in the best viewing path and wide partial views elsewhere.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would organize the eclipse glasses perfectly, and who would turn the whole thing into a rooftop snack event?

topics.title: British Columbia gets wildfire help
topics.summary: Canada has put military support on standby as British Columbia wildfires force thousands from home, while about 100 Mexican firefighters arrive to help local crews.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone had to pack a go-bag in ten minutes, who would be practical, and who would bring something completely unnecessary?

topics.title: UK heat keeps pressure on summer
topics.summary: The UK is on course for its hottest summer on record, with heat alerts, drought concerns and wildfire risk keeping weather and water planning in focus.
topics.discussionPrompt: On an unbearably hot day, who becomes the fan-and-ice expert, and who insists they are totally fine while melting?

topics.title: Athletics fans question high prices
topics.summary: European Athletics Championships organizers in Birmingham face criticism after high ticket and food prices were blamed for empty seats at Alexander Stadium.
topics.discussionPrompt: What event would the group pay to watch, and what stadium snack price would make everyone start dramatically budgeting?
